title: Approval
description: A user's decision on a proposal (API-031; table approvals). Stores the single-use nonce, never the approval token or the server key (C4).

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce bound into the token (API-031). Not a secret on its own; format not fixed by the spec.

outcome.description: Command names from API_SPEC §4; the spec names no other outcome values.
